calm_down.definition: To bring your body back to quiet so you can think and speak.
calm_down.example: Let us calm down first, then talk.

dual_counter_argument.definition: The argument made against a decision that is still being considered.
dual_counter_argument.example: The counter-argument was short, and it changed the decision.

green_light.definition: To give formal permission for something to go ahead.
green_light.example: Legal has green-lighted the launch for June.

mia_ad_hominem.definition: An attack on the person instead of on the claim.
mia_ad_hominem.example: You did not read the report, so your opinion does not count is an ad hominem.

mixed_signals.definition: When one person's behaviour and words point in different directions, usually because they are unsure or unwilling to say where things stand.
mixed_signals.example: He texts every day but has cancelled three plans — those are mixed signals.
